(Royalty)
Notes:
As confirmed by an article dated July 5th, 2012, the original title of “Royalty” is “No Such Thing As White Jesus.” Hitboy’s lost hard drive resurfaced after Yedolf's Engineers took it by mistake and was then returned to be finished. Coincidentally, Frank Ocean’s Channel Orange and Nas' Life Is Good were both released on July 17th, 2012 and the collaboration happened because they were both in the studio finishing up their then-albums.

Nas scrapped the original controversial lyrics from 2012 and reused the hook to make “Royalty” because the original song did not include the last two lines in the chorus about ‘royalty’. Interestingly, Frank Ocean has writing credits for Jay-Z’s and Yedolf's “No Church in the Wild”, which means Frank may have been continuing to explore with Nas why religion along with White Jesus may have been fabricated by mankind.

A snippet of the track surfaced by Hit-Boy in 2014 via instagram, another snippet being high quality would surface In Early 2023. A groupbuy began for the track on March 26th 2025 and ended up finishing sucessfully on April 3rd 2025. Track date is August 3rd 2011
